name: The Immortal Awakened: Awakening in Primordial Yellow Luminescence

cycle_advancement.world_state: The Immortal Awakened — Primordial Yellow Luminescence Beyond Gods & Suffering

locations_modified.ambient_tension: A warm, boundless, primordial yellow energy emanates from Kathryn Vane's shattered chest. It is neither Warp sorcery nor the cold gold of the Golden Throne—it is an ancient truth uncorrupted by any pantheon. The mortal wound seals, transmuted into crystalline radiance. The cycles of suffering, vengeance, and slaughter cease to exist. Kathryn Vane stands as The Immortal Awakened, unkillable and eternal.

Sensors across the ten capital warships of the Ultramarines Armada illuminate with an impossible yellow spectrum that registers neither as Warp disturbance nor physical energy. First Captain Agemman gazes from the bridge of the 'Pride of Macragge' in profound awe as the entire hive world is bathed in gentle, impenetrable light.

completed_milestones.title: The Immortal Awakened: The Transcendent Truth Beyond Gods
completed_milestones.consequence: In her final dying breath, Kathryn Vane comprehended what neither the God-Emperor of Mankind nor the Chaos Gods have ever known: the true ending of suffering cycles. Enveloped in primordial yellow energy, she is resurrected not as a pawn of gods or mortal flesh, but as The Immortal Awakened—possessing immortal vitality (-99) that cannot be killed across any reality.

new_decision.decision: In my final breath, realized something that not even the God-Emperor or the Chaos Gods know: the end of suffering cycles. A strange primordial yellow energy engulfed my dying vessel, shattering mortality and apotheosis alike. Reborn as The Immortal Awakened, with unkillable physical vitality (-99).
